_comment: Declarative CRUD lifecycles. Steps run in order: create -> read -> [update] -> delete. {placeholders} are filled from earlier 'capture' values plus {unique} (collision-free token) and {region}. Mutating steps need SCP_ALLOW_MUTATIONS=true; steps marked destructive also need SCP_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true. A step may declare "wait": <s> (sleep before it) or "poll": {field, until, timeout, interval} to wait for async provisioning. Enable a lifecycle with "enabled": true.

lifecycles._note: Create a resource-group, read it, then set it + write/list/delete a tag on its SRN (each optional+grouped), probe path-param GETs, delete. COVERAGE EXPANSION (not dispatch-validated): setresourcegroup, updateresourcetags, listresourcetags, deleteresourcetag. rg_srn is soft-captured; if absent the tag steps isolate to their group.

Read-only: list account-quotas + quota-requests, soft-capture an id each, probe the 2 path-param GETs (showaccountquota/showquotarequest). No writes/cleanup. Envelope/id grounded from docs ($.account_quotas[].id, $.quota_requests[].id). Runs in CRUD mode (engine gates all lifecycles on SCP_ALLOW_MUTATIONS); env-dependent (records SOFT if the account has no quota-requests).

Every NEW write is optional+grouped so a rejection isolates to its group (tears down just that group) and never fails the expensive VM run; the validated create->...->delete spine is unchanged. lock/unlock intentionally omitted (risk of stranding a billable VM if unlock fails).

json.name: regrpsub{unique}
json.description: API regression VS standalone port subnet

steps._note: HB3b-2 (2026-07-06, run 28766151214): attach-port-to-server 400 `VirtualServer.CreateInterface.Duplicated` — the server already has an interface in `{subnet_id}` (its own boot NIC, created by create-server earlier in this same lifecycle), and this lifecycle has no second/shared subnet to point the standalone test port at (unlike the DB-engine `-full` lifecycles' `adopt: subnet#db` pattern — checked, not present here). Fix: give the vs-port group its OWN subnet in the same VPC (`10.135.3.0/24`, free — the lifecycle's only other subnet is `10.135.2.0/24` inside the VPC's `10.135.0.0/20`), so create-port/attach-port-to-server target a subnet the server has no existing interface on. Scoped to the `vs-port` group (own create+cleanup) so a rejection here tears down just this subnet, never the main VM spine. | 2026-07-08 (owner '이 400/404 해결하자'): 라이브 400의 진짜 원인 확정 — 이 lifecycle 은 공유 VPC(10.124.0.0/20)를 ADOPT 하므로 10.135.3.0/24 는 VPC 대역 밖 → scp-network 400 (run 20260708-121432 POST /v1/subnets 400). 전용 /24 를 공유 /20 안의 빈 대역 10.124.8.0/24 로 재배정 (0=공유메인 · 1-6=fallback 예약 · 7=DB · 9=networking-vpc). fixed IP 도 10.124.8.10/.11 로 이동.

steps.name: create-port
steps._note: HB3b (2026-07-05, run 28723287734): CONFIRMED live 400 `scp-network.port.fixed_ip.format-error` ("The requested Fixed IP() is invalid IP format." — note the empty parens) when `fixed_ip_address` was sent as `""`. data/api_docs.json networking/vpc/portcreaterequest documents the field as `any of [string, null]` (optional, default "") and the doc's own request_example literally sends `"fixed_ip_address":""` — so the DOCUMENTED default is rejected live; fix is to OMIT the key entirely (let the backend auto-assign from the subnet) rather than send an empty string. This unblocks the whole vs-port group (map-sg-to-port/attach-port-to-server/read-attached-port/detach-port-from-server/delete-port — 6 catalog keys share this group, previously 404-demoted once create-port failed). Not re-verified live this session (offline-only, no SCP calls) — next HEAVY dispatch should confirm 2xx. HB3b-2 (2026-07-06): `subnet_id` switched from `{subnet_id}` (the server's own subnet) to `{port_subnet_id}` (new dedicated subnet, see create-port-subnet) — see attach-port-to-server note for why. 2026-07-08 (owner review): omit 가설은 라이브 미검증인 채로 두고 **유효 IP 명시로 확정** — `fixed_ip_address: 10.135.3.10` (전용 /24 안, 게이트웨이 예약대 회피). absent를 백엔드가 ""처럼 다루든 아니든 성공 형태이며, format-error 계열이 원천 차단된다. 다음 heavy 런이 vs-port 6-endpoint 체인(갭이던 detach DELETE 포함)의 2xx 를 확인해야 함. | 2026-07-08(2): port-subnet CIDR 가 adopt-VPC 대역 밖(10.135.x)이라 400 → 10.124.8.0/24 로 교정, fixed_ip 10.124.8.10 (create-port-subnet note 참고).

steps.name: attach-port-to-server
steps._note: 2026-07-08(3) owner run: port_id+subnet_id 동시 전송 400 — 같은 런 netops attach(port_id 단독) 200 라이브 증명 → subnet_id 제거. | HB3b-2 (2026-07-06, run 28766151214): CONFIRMED live 400 `VirtualServer.CreateInterface.Duplicated` when this sent `subnet_id: {subnet_id}` — that's the server's OWN boot subnet, and it already has an interface there (create-server). Switched to `{port_subnet_id}` (the dedicated vs-port-group subnet created by create-port-subnet, matching create-port's own subnet_id) so the new interface lands on a subnet the server has no prior interface on. Not re-verified live this session (offline-only).

Explicitly deleting it right after the server is confirmed gone (`wait-server-gone` 404) closes that window directly, instead of leaning on the account-wide reconciler sweep's TTL/own-run heuristics (`cleanup/reconciler.py _is_deletable`) to reclaim it later. `optional:true` + broad `expect_status` (400/404 included) so a volume the cascade DID already reap (404), or one still mid-detach (400), never fails the lifecycle. Not re-verified live this session (offline-only) — next HEAVY dispatch should confirm the final sweep no longer needs an IGNORE_TTL rescue for this lifecycle's boot volume.
